title: 18 Walkinstown Road, Walkinstown, Dublin 12
description:
RAY COOKE AUCTIONEERS are delighted to present this truly special four-bedroom, two-bathroom terraced home to the market at No. 18 Walkinstown Road, Dublin 12.
While the property requires a significant degree of modernisation, it offers an exciting opportunity for those looking to create a substantial family home in an exceptionally well-established and highly sought-after location. The generous proportions, extra-high ceilings and excellent overall footprint provide an ideal canvas for renovation, with huge potential to transform the existing accommodation into a stunning home tailored to the needs and tastes of the new owner.

The property benefits from an enviable position on Walkinstown Road, with a host of amenities and excellent transport links close by. Walkinstown Shopping Centre, local shops, schools, parks and recreational facilities are all within easy reach, while the M50, N7 and Dublin City Centre are readily accessible. A wealth of bus routes also provide convenient access throughout the city and surrounding areas, making this an ideal location for owner-occupiers and investors alike.

Internally, the accommodation is well proportioned and boasts four bedrooms, two bathrooms and the added benefit of two separate reception rooms. The extra-high ceilings further enhance the sense of space and offer scope to restore and showcase some of the property's original character. To the rear lies a particularly impressive large garden, complete with a substantial workshop, providing excellent outdoor space and a multitude of potential uses.

Further enhancing the appeal is rear laneway access, offering superb convenience and potential for future use. The combination of generous accommodation, substantial rear space, workshop, garage and highly desirable location makes this a property with enormous potential for the discerning purchaser.

No. 18 Walkinstown Road comes to the market vacant with no onward chain, allowing the successful purchaser to begin their plans without delay. This is a rare opportunity to acquire a substantial home in an excellent Dublin 12 location and, with the right vision, create something truly special.

Features

• 4 bed/2 bath Semi-Detached home
• C. 120sqm
• BER E
• Requires modernisation throughout
• Excellent potential to create a superb family home
• Two separate reception rooms
• Impressive extra-high ceilings
• Large rear garden
• Substantial workshop to rear
• Garage
• Rear laneway access
• Excellent location close to a host of amenities
• Vacant with no onward chain
• Ideal for families, owner-occupiers and investors
